purpose: Close the CTR-JOB-001 reference-field defect that WP-0A-CON-002 escalated rather than changed: input_ref and result_ref are constrained by a deny-list matching only a literal lowercase http(s) prefix, which independent security review proved bypassable and which this package re-measured against the shipped schema before changing anything. Replace it with the CTR-IDM-001 allow-listed-scheme-plus-constrained-body treatment, add the standing guard that makes a recurrence a CI failure, and do so as a content-neutral amendment that changes no field, no version and no freeze level.

include: RFC-2026-006 recording the measured defect, the authority for amending a Candidate contract's delivered content, and the structural content-neutrality proof
The two CTR-JOB-001 reference constraints, each carrying an x-reference-rule naming the demonstrated bypasses, plus an x-amended-by record
A negative fixture using a form the previous deny-list ACCEPTED, declared in the CTR-JOB-001 manifest
The two shipped CTR-JOB-001 fixtures whose input_ref does not satisfy the tightened schema
The WP-0A-CON-001 catalog test assertions that pinned the defective deny-list in place, and its acceptance predicate that carried the same bypasses
A standing guard suite exercising every demonstrated hostile form on both reference fields

ownership.forbidden_paths_note: The globs **/*secret* and **/*credential* were removed: they forbade this package's own declared outputs (the secret scanner and its test), a contradiction the ownership validator could not see until it began comparing outputs against forbidden_paths. acceptance_criteria: The defect was re-measured against the shipped schema with the repository's own subset validator BEFORE any change, and the accepted forms recorded. The escalation was not taken on trust.

Every hostile form independent security review demonstrated - uppercase and mixed-case scheme, protocol-relative authority, ftp:, data:, file:, javascript: and bare traversal - is rejected on BOTH input_ref and result_ref, and so are the four forms that defeat a scheme allow-list with a free body.
A well-formed private reference is still accepted on both fields, so the guard is not vacuously strict.

The two reference fields use the CTR-IDM-001 pattern verbatim and carry no deny-list, and both patterns are identical to each other so the two fields cannot drift apart. (2026-10-05: the two fields also must not admit a WHATWG special scheme. The standing guard asserts it as a property, C0 F4 / C3.)

The amendment is content-neutral as a MEASURED structural property: the parsed schema before and after differs only at the two reference constraints and the x-amended-by annotation, with zero leaf paths modified in place, no property added or removed, an unchanged required list, an unchanged tenant_context $ref, version 1.0.0 and freeze level Candidate.
The WP-0A-CON-002 x-amended-by record is carried forward deep-equal, not overwritten.

rollback_or_forward_fix: Refreshed 2026-10-05 (R0 integration verdict R5): a revert of this package ALONE is no longer safe. When this field was first written nothing implemented CTR-JOB-001. Since migration 050 (db/foundation/migrations/050_async_kernel.sql, commit cbbc6cb, on main) app.jobs enforces this same lookahead-free pattern, character for character, with length <= 256, as CHECK constraints jobs_input_ref_form and jobs_result_ref_form. Reverting the contract alone would make CTR-JOB-001 wider than the database, a contract/database mismatch, which is a stop-the-line class. The rollback is therefore a forward fix; a revert, if ever chosen, must go through a reviewed revert PR paired with a reviewed forward migration that relaxes those two CHECK constraints (an integrated migration is never rewritten), owned by the database package, not by this one. What a revert of this package restores, for reference: the deny-list, the two fixtures' synthetic:// values and the two WP-0A-CON-001 test assertions, and it removes the negative fixture and the standing guard. No provider state, credential or customer-data effect exists. Reverting also restores the bypasses, so a revert must be paired with re-opening the WP-0A-CON-002 escalation rather than closing it.

CTR-JOB-001 job_type, lease_owner, progress_stage and last_error_code carry no maxLength and no pattern. Each accepts 100,000 characters, a credential-shaped body, an email address, a phone number or a page of user content (A1 S3, Medium). max_attempts, timeout_seconds, attempt and job_version have no upper bound, and priority is unbounded in both directions, so retry-storm and queue-starvation shapes conform (A1 S8, Low). DISCLOSURE ONLY, NOT CLOSURE: bounding these fields is a contract decision outside this package's scope. It is escalated to the CTR-JOB-001 owner as a required_before_freeze item, exactly as WP-0A-CON-002 escalated the reference defect to this package.

A conforming reference can carry up to 252 opaque body characters (maxLength 256 less the shortest scheme with its colon, job: or app:; content: leaves 248) (corrected 2026-10-05, C0 re-verify N5: first written as 248; measured with the repository validator: job: plus 252 characters accepted, plus 253 rejected, on both fields), and those can be credential-shaped or PII-shaped. x-reference-rule states the rejections at length and does not state this residual (A1 S5, Medium). The constraint is a shape rule, not a content rule. Escalated to the CTR-JOB-001 owner with the item above.
